records.topic: MTBF / MTTF / MTTR availability formula

sourceEvidence.title: Formulas: Inherent Availability and Reliability with Constant Failure and Repair Rates
sourceEvidence.supports: NASA's steady-state inherent-availability formula is A = MTBF/(MTBF + MTTR) under its stated constant failure/repair rate model; it defines MTBF as mean time between failure and MTTR as mean time to repair.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The formula is tied to the source's model and nomenclature. Some texts use MTTF for mean operating time to failure and write A = MTTF/(MTTF + MTTR). These expressions require consistent definitions of the uptime interval and MTBF. The NASA formula does not support the answer's separate blanket identity MTBF = MTTF + MTTR without qualifying the term definitions.

sourceEvidence.title: Reliability-Centered Maintenance Guide for Facilities and Collateral Equipment
sourceEvidence.supports: Section 14.3 gives inherent availability Ai = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR) and describes MTBF as mean time between failure (also, mean time to failure); the glossary calls MTTR mean time to repair.
sourceEvidence.limitations: This 2008 guide uses MTBF and MTTF as alternative nomenclature for the operating/failure interval. It does not support the answer's claim that MTBF is necessarily MTTF + MTTR. Use one definition consistently, and distinguish inherent availability from operational availability.

records.conclusion: 解析一边用 MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR) 计算 999/(999+1)=99.9%，该计算符合 NASA 给出的稳态固有可用性公式及其 MTBF/MTTR 口径；但解析随后称“MTBF = MTTF + MTTR”并改用 A=MTTF/(MTTF+MTTR)，未先定义这两种平均时间的计量起止点，造成术语口径矛盾。答案 C 可在题目默认 MTBF 指平均运行间隔的常见口径下得到支持，但整段解析仍需澄清定义。
records.recommendedAction: 采用单一术语口径：若题目按固有可用性惯用式 A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR) 并给定 MTBF=999 h、MTTR=1 h，则保留 C=99.9%，删除或重写“MTBF=MTTF+MTTR”的混用解释；如果将 MTBF 定义为已包含修复时间的日历间隔，则应重新给出相互一致的公式及题目参数。来源支持公式范围，不代表整道题已经完成权威答案认证。

records.topic: Redis AOF everysec durability wording

sourceEvidence.title: Redis persistence
sourceEvidence.supports: Redis 文档说明 appendfsync everysec 会每秒同步一次；发生灾难时可能丢失约一秒写入。
sourceEvidence.limitations: “可能丢失一秒”是对该刷盘策略的说明，不是对所有文件系统、存储设备、内核缓存和故障类型的无条件严格上限。不同 Redis 托管产品的持久化说明不可直接互相套用。

records.conclusion: 原解析中“最多丢失1秒”将配置策略描述成绝对上限，措辞过强。
records.recommendedAction: 改成“appendfsync everysec 会按秒执行 fsync；按 Redis 文档说明，灾难故障时可能丢失约一秒写入。实际结果受故障与存储栈影响，不把它当作严格的全场景上限”。

records.topic: Unqualified TLS latency and encryption overhead estimates

sourceEvidence.title: RFC 8446: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3
sourceEvidence.supports: TLS 1.3 specifies a full handshake and PSK-resumption handshakes; ordinary full handshake completion depends on protocol messages and network round trips. The RFC permits 0-RTT early data in resumption but documents weaker security properties and replay considerations.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The protocol specification does not give a universal application latency penalty in milliseconds. Actual overhead depends on connection reuse, resumption, network path, payload sizes, implementation, hardware and load; it cannot substantiate the 10–50 ms or 1–5 ms figures without measurements.

records.conclusion: “TLS 加密不影响业务延迟”是无条件断言；TLS 建连/握手与加解密可能引入网络往返及计算开销。RFC 8446 对完整握手和恢复连接有所区分，也说明 0-RTT 恢复数据存在额外重放风险；它不支持“零延迟”或通用的 10–50ms、1–5ms 性能数字。
records.recommendedAction: 改为“TLS 会带来与握手、连接复用、加密实现和网络路径有关的开销，具体影响须在目标环境做端到端基准测试”。删除 10–50ms/1–5ms 数字，或给出可复现测试设置与原始结果。来源：[RFC 8446](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8446)。

sourceEvidence.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

records.topic: Kafka producer batch.size and linger.ms tuning recommendations

sourceEvidence.title: Producer Configs (Apache Kafka 4.0)
sourceEvidence.supports: The official producer configuration reference explains that batch.size controls the default per-partition batch size; small batches can reduce throughput while very large batch allocations can waste memory. linger.ms caps the extra batching wait, and Kafka 4.0 documents a 5 ms default (changed from 0 in 4.0); increasing linger can reduce request count while adding latency for low-load traffic.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The documentation supports the mechanism and trade-off, not that 64 KiB→256 KiB or 0→20 ms is optimal for every workload. Tuning requires traffic-shape, throughput, p95/p99 latency, memory and broker measurements. Historical defaults differ by Kafka version.

records.conclusion: 增大批次与 linger 时间是可以测试的吞吐量优化方向，但 256 KiB 与 20 ms 只是候选参数，不是跨版本、跨负载的通用最佳值；较高 linger 会带来延迟/吞吐权衡。
records.recommendedAction: 保留为待基准验证的优化建议；明确 Kafka 版本，使用代表性负载测量吞吐量、尾延迟和内存，按业务延迟 SLO 调优，不要把示例值写成通用结论。

records.topic: CQRS eventual-consistency lag and zero-impact isolation claim

targets.claimNeedle: 同步延迟通常在1秒以内（最终一致性）
完全与在线业务隔离，不影响MySQL性能

sourceEvidence.title: Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) pattern
sourceEvidence.supports: CQRS can separate read/write models and optimize/scaling them independently. When stores are separated, they must be synchronized; eventual consistency means read data can be stale, and messaging/outbox/idempotency need explicit handling.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The guidance does not promise read-model lag under one second and does not mean synchronization has zero resource impact on the source database. The observed lag depends on workload, connector, queues, indexing, failures and catch-up behavior.

records.conclusion: CQRS 可以把在线查询和写模型的查询负载分离并允许不同扩缩容，但不能由此推出同步通常一定小于 1 秒，更不能声称同步链路对 MySQL 完全没有性能影响。
records.recommendedAction: 将“1 秒以内”改成项目目标或实测 SLA，并注明 P95/P99、负载、持续时间和积压恢复测试；把“完全隔离、不影响性能”改为“降低在线查询对主库的直接压力，但 CDC/binlog、网络与同步组件仍会消耗资源，需监测与压测”。

records.topic: Kafka exactly-once processing scope and external destination caveat

targets.claimNeedle: 实现端到端精确一次语义

sourceEvidence.title: Design — Apache Kafka
sourceEvidence.supports: Kafka documents exactly-once delivery for Kafka Streams and for transactional read-process-write flows involving Kafka topics with transactional producers and read_committed consumers.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The design page explicitly says exactly-once delivery to other destination systems generally requires cooperation from those systems, such as coordinating output persistence and consumed offsets or using destination-side idempotency/transactions. The primitives alone do not guarantee arbitrary external side effects are executed exactly once.

records.conclusion: Kafka 0.11+ 引入的事务与幂等机制可为 Kafka 内部读—处理—写主题提供精确一次能力；若结果写入外部数据库、HTTP 服务或其他系统，必须由目标系统协同事务、原子保存 offset/结果或幂等去重，不能笼统宣称组合参数就保证任意端到端精确一次。
records.recommendedAction: 把答案范围明确为“Kafka 主题内读、处理、写可借助事务实现精确一次；对外部系统需目标存储协同事务或幂等处理”。若用“端到端”，必须写清起止系统与事务边界。

records.topic: Bitmap block count depends on binary versus SI storage units

sourceEvidence.title: SI prefixes
sourceEvidence.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)
sourceEvidence.supports: The SI prefixes giga (G) and mega (M) represent decimal factors 10^9 and 10^6, respectively.
sourceEvidence.limitations: This defines SI decimal prefixes; it does not determine the unstated unit convention intended by an older Chinese exam question.

sourceEvidence.title: Definitions of the SI units: The binary prefixes
sourceEvidence.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sourceEvidence.supports: NIST describes IEC binary prefixes such as Ki, Mi and Gi for powers of 2; for example 1 GiB = 2^30 bytes, while 1 GB = 10^9 bytes.
sourceEvidence.limitations: This clarifies unit notation, not the exam author's intended convention. The multiple-choice options indicate the intended calculation uses 1 GB = 1024 MB.

records.conclusion: 按题目常见的二进制换算约定，300×1024/4=76,800 个物理块，每块需要 1 位，32 位一字，因此 76,800/32=2,400 字，选项 A 与该约定一致。严格按 SI 十进制 GB/MB 计算则块数为 75,000，位示图需要向上取整至 2,344 个 32 位字；题干没有明示单位约定，因此这是约定敏感题而非纯粹无条件的算术结论。
records.recommendedAction: 解析显式写明“按本题约定 1GB=1024MB、1MB=1024KB”或使用 GiB/MiB 等二进制单位符号；不要把 GB/MB 一律定义为 1024 进制。

records.topic: Kafka consumer session timeout default is version-dependent

sourceEvidence.title: Consumer Configurations (Apache Kafka 2.4)
sourceEvidence.supports: Kafka 2.4's consumer configuration lists session.timeout.ms default as 10,000 ms and max.poll.interval.ms default as 300,000 ms.
sourceEvidence.limitations: These are version-specific defaults for Kafka 2.4; they should not be presented as current defaults without a version caveat.

sourceEvidence.title: Consumer Configurations (Apache Kafka 4.0)
sourceEvidence.supports: Kafka 4.0's classic consumer protocol lists session.timeout.ms default as 45,000 ms and max.poll.interval.ms default as 300,000 ms. With the newer consumer group protocol, the session timeout is broker-controlled and the client setting is not supported.
sourceEvidence.limitations: Actual behavior depends on Kafka version, group.protocol, broker limits and configured overrides. The displayed values are defaults, not mandatory runtime values.

sourceEvidence.title: Upgrading to Kafka 2.4 — Cooperative Rebalancing
sourceEvidence.supports: CooperativeStickyAssignor is available with Kafka 2.4-era clients; the upgrade guidance requires rolling consumers through a compatibility phase and removing the old assignor only after group members support the cooperative protocol.
sourceEvidence.limitations: This does not mean enabling one consumer alone immediately makes the whole group safely cooperative; compatible client versions and a deliberate migration path are required.

records.conclusion: “默认10s”是 Kafka 2.4 时代可成立的版本信息；Kafka 3.0/4.x 文档已将经典消费者协议的默认值列为 45 秒，Kafka 4.0 的新 consumer group protocol 则由 broker 配置 session timeout。max.poll.interval.ms 默认 5 分钟在这些版本中仍有官方支持。CooperativeStickyAssignor 从 2.4 时代起可用，但组内消费者要按兼容升级步骤迁移，因此这段答案应标注适用版本与协议，而不是直接称所有数字错误。
records.recommendedAction: 把 session.timeout.ms 的默认值标成“Kafka 2.4/2.6 等旧版为 10 秒；Kafka 3.0+ 经典协议默认 45 秒，具体以版本、group.protocol 与 broker 配置为准”；将 max.poll.interval.ms 的 5 分钟保留为版本化默认值；说明 CooperativeStickyAssignor 需要所有成员支持并按官方升级流程滚动迁移。

records.topic: AES-128/AES-256 round count versus speed and simplified quantum-security claims

targets.claimNeedle: 抗量子计算有效安全强度128位

sourceEvidence.title: FIPS 197: Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
sourceEvidence.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sourceEvidence.supports: NIST specifies AES-128 with 10 rounds and AES-256 with 14 rounds; the suffix identifies key length in bits.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The standard specifies the algorithm and rounds, not a general benchmark claiming AES-256 is exactly 40 percent slower than AES-128 on all implementations.

sourceEvidence.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography FAQ
sourceEvidence.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sourceEvidence.supports: NIST discusses Grover-style quantum search as reducing brute-force work quadratically in an idealized model, while emphasizing assumptions and stating that this does not make current AES use immediately unsafe.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The phrase “128-bit effective strength” is shorthand for a generic square-root search model, not an unconditional NIST certification of AES-256's complete quantum security; practical cost also depends on quantum circuit depth, parallelization and resource assumptions.

records.conclusion: NIST FIPS 197 supports the key-size/round-count fact (AES-128: 10 rounds; AES-256: 14) and AES-256 has a 256-bit key space. It does not support a workload-independent 40% performance penalty. “Quantum-effective 128 bits” is a simplified generic Grover-search heuristic and should not be stated as an unconditional cipher security rating; NIST's PQC FAQ stresses attack-model/resource assumptions and notes AES remains safe under current guidance.
records.recommendedAction: 保留轮数和密钥长度；删除无基准条件的“慢 40%”，或附具体处理器、AES-NI/库版本、模式、数据长度与基准测试。量子安全说明应明确为通用 Grover 搜索的近似工作量解释，并避免写成 NIST 已保证的精确有效强度。

records.topic: Envoy Sidecar latency range and negligible threshold

targets.claimNeedle: Envoy Sidecar单跳额外延迟通常在0.5-2ms
对绝大多数业务（响应时间>50ms）影响可忽略

sourceEvidence.title: What are best practices for benchmarking Envoy?
sourceEvidence.supports: Envoy 官方文档指出，不存在一个能概括代理 QPS、延迟或吞吐开销的单一数值；性能测试必须考虑具体配置与工作负载，并建议在目标环境进行有可比性的基准测试。
sourceEvidence.limitations: 该文档不提供统一的单跳毫秒值，也不能证明任何具体部署一定增加多少延迟；0.5–2ms 和以 50ms 为阈值的可忽略结论需要目标环境的基准测试与业务 SLO 支持。

records.conclusion: 单跳通常增加 0.5–2ms 与响应时间超过 50ms 即可忽略这两项说法缺少测试配置、硬件、请求/连接特征、代理过滤器、TLS/HTTP 设置和测量方法；官方文档明确指出不存在一个通用代理延迟基准。
records.recommendedAction: 把 0.5–2ms 标成待验证的示例估计，或删除普遍化表述；应在接近生产的 Envoy 配置下比较直连与代理路径，报告请求大小、并发、连接复用、TLS、硬件、样本量及 p50/p95/p99 延迟。是否可忽略应依据具体业务预算，而不是用统一的 50ms 门槛。

records.topic: Direct-mapped cache Tag-bit calculation and binary MB/KB convention
records.conclusion: 按题目常见的二进制容量约定，256MB=2^28 B、512KB=2^19 B、64B=2^6 B；Cache 有 2^13 行，主存地址标记位为 28−13−6=9 位，选项 A 与该约定一致。若将 MB/KB 解作十进制 SI 单位，位数前提不同，题目应明示约定。
records.recommendedAction: 标记为带二进制单位前提的计算复核；建议在解析明确 1MB=2^20 B、1KB=2^10 B，而不是把缩写约定当作无歧义定义。

records.topic: Round-robin CPU time per process over a 100 ms cycle

targets.claimNeedle: 每个进程在100ms内获得1个时间片即20ms的CPU时间

records.conclusion: 不计进程切换开销且 5 个进程均在就绪队列轮流得到一个完整时间片时，一轮为 5×20ms=100ms，每个进程在此轮获得 20ms CPU 时间，答案 B 与题设一致。
records.recommendedAction: 保留题设前提“不考虑切换开销”和“5 个进程都持续就绪”；计算复核不证明题源或其他调度细节。

records.topic: Availability calculation from MTTF 990 h and MTTR 10 h
records.conclusion: 按 A=MTTF/(MTTF+MTTR) 的给定口径，990/(990+10)=990/1000=0.99，即 99%，与选项 A 一致。
records.recommendedAction: 保留公式与给定时间口径；此项仅复核算术和常用稳态可用性模型内的答案，不替代题源核验。

records.topic: Two-level file index capacity under 4 KiB blocks
records.conclusion: 按 4 KiB 数据/索引块和 4-byte block address，单个索引块可放 1024 个地址，二级索引覆盖 1024² 个数据块，总容量 1024²×4 KiB=4 GiB。数值与选项 A 在二进制单位习惯下吻合，但题目使用 KB/GB 缩写时需说明是否按 1024 换算。
records.recommendedAction: 明确采用 KiB/GiB 或写出 1KB=1024B 的题设约定；若“二级索引”含义在教材中有不同定义，应同步说明这是两层索引块的解释。

records.topic: FaaS cold-start latency quoted as a general 1–10 second range

sourceEvidence.title: Understanding the Lambda execution environment lifecycle
sourceEvidence.supports: AWS Lambda 文档说明冷启动耗时可从低于100毫秒到超过1秒，且初始化延迟受运行时、代码包/依赖以及初始化工作的影响。
sourceEvidence.limitations: 该描述只针对 AWS Lambda 的文档范围，不提供适用于所有 FaaS 平台的通用区间；并不支持把“通常1–10秒”当作跨平台的固定范围。具体项目应针对目标运行时、配置和负载实测。

records.conclusion: “冷启动延迟通常为1–10秒”未限定平台，且把一个宽泛估计写成普遍范围。AWS Lambda 官方文档给出的冷启动耗时可从低于100毫秒到超过1秒，强调实现与初始化内容会影响耗时，因此无法支持该句作为所有FaaS的统一通用值。
records.recommendedAction: 限定为目标平台/运行时并引用相应官方文档；更稳妥的写法是冷启动延迟差异较大，需按运行时、依赖包大小、初始化代码、内存/CPU配置及是否使用预置并发或快照技术进行测量。不要将1–10秒推广至所有FaaS。

records.topic: Two-job CPU/I-O overlap scheduling minimum completion time
records.conclusion: 按题目给定执行顺序且不计调度与切换开销：P1 在 0–40ms 使用 CPU、40–100ms 做 I/O；P2 在 20ms 到达，40–140ms 使用 CPU，140–180ms 做 I/O；P1 可在 140–160ms 完成最后 20ms CPU 计算，P2 随后在 180–220ms 完成最后 40ms CPU 计算。因此整个作业集在 220ms 完成，选项 D 与该调度一致。
records.recommendedAction: 保留给定的到达时刻、串行CPU和可并行I/O假设，并说明不考虑调度/切换开销；这只是按题面时间线的计算复核。

records.topic: Circuit-breaker failure-rate and open-state wait are implementation-specific settings

targets.claimNeedle: 经过超时时间（如30秒）后，自动进入半开状态

sourceEvidence.title: CircuitBreaker
sourceEvidence.supports: Resilience4j documents configurable circuit-breaker properties and lists a 50% failure-rate threshold as the default. Its implementation documents a 60-second default open-state wait duration.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The cited values are defaults for Resilience4j, not universal defaults across all circuit-breaker libraries or business systems. A 30-second wait can be a deliberate custom setting and needs workload/fault-recovery justification.

records.conclusion: 50% failure rate and 30 seconds open-state wait are presented as example values. Resilience4j uses 50% as a default failure-rate threshold but a 60-second default wait duration; circuit-breaker defaults differ by implementation and can be configured. This evidence does not make 30 seconds incorrect, but it cannot be presented as a universal standard.
records.recommendedAction: Name the intended library/version and treat 50%/30s as example settings. Tune the threshold, minimum calls/window, slow-call thresholds and wait duration using downstream failure behavior, traffic volume and recovery SLOs; verify with fault-injection tests.

records.topic: Agent heartbeat interval, missed-heartbeat count, and task timeout are design choices

targets.claimNeedle: 每个Agent每30秒向Orchestrator发送心跳消息
连续3次未收到心跳（90秒）判定Agent故障

records.conclusion: 30-second heartbeat, three missed heartbeats/90 seconds, and five-minute task timeouts are plausible example settings, not universal reliability rules. Their suitability depends on execution duration distribution, scheduling pauses, network variance, clock/lease behavior, task idempotency and the cost of false failure detection.
records.recommendedAction: Label these as sample configuration rather than fixed requirements. Choose heartbeat interval and miss threshold using expected detection time and tolerated false positives; choose task timeouts from observed duration percentiles and define retry, cancellation, idempotency and dead-letter handling together.

records.topic: An 85% text-similarity score is a screening heuristic, not a universal cheating verdict

targets.claimNeedle: 相似度超过阈值（如85%）标记为可疑

sourceEvidence.title: Plagiarism and what are acceptable similarity scores?
sourceEvidence.supports: Turnitin explains that a similarity score indicates how much text matches sources in its database and is not itself a determination that plagiarism occurred; an educator must review the context.
sourceEvidence.limitations: Turnitin uses its own comparison corpus and algorithm. It does not validate this project’s SimHash/TF-IDF method or provide an official universal 85% threshold.

records.conclusion: The answer explicitly frames 85% as an example threshold. It is not a standard threshold across similarity algorithms, question types or answer lengths, and a high score alone does not prove cheating. False positives can arise from shared prompts, standard terminology, citations or common solution patterns.
records.recommendedAction: Retain only as a configurable example. Calibrate against labeled benign and suspicious submissions, stratify by question type/answer length, document false-positive/false-negative rates and route flags to human review rather than automatic penalties.

records.topic: Zero-trust session expiry and device-posture reporting intervals are risk-based settings

targets.claimNeedle: 缩短会话有效期（如30分钟）
定期（如每5分钟）上报设备安全状态

sourceEvidence.title: Session Management
sourceEvidence.supports: NIST SP 800-63B describes overall and inactivity timeouts and says their limits depend on factors including authentication assurance level, environment, endpoint/device management and application nature.
sourceEvidence.limitations: It does not prescribe a universal 30-minute timeout for all zero-trust systems or applications.

sourceEvidence.title: Zero Trust Architecture (SP 800-207)
sourceEvidence.supports: Zero-trust architecture uses policy decisions and access to resources based on current identity/context; device and session risk should be evaluated as part of access policy.
sourceEvidence.limitations: The publication does not establish a universal five-minute device-posture polling interval; intervals must reflect threat model, telemetry freshness and operational cost.

records.conclusion: The 30-minute session lifetime and five-minute device-posture polling interval are illustrative values, not universal zero-trust requirements. NIST’s session guidance makes timeouts context-dependent and SP 800-207 does not prescribe a universal polling interval.
records.recommendedAction: Label both intervals as examples. Define overall/inactivity session limits from assurance level and application risk, require reauthentication for high-risk actions, and choose posture freshness intervals based on device risk, telemetry latency, network/load overhead and the desired response time to a compromised device.

records.topic: Edge telemetry design claims more than 100x data-volume reduction
records.conclusion: 边缘预处理与特征提取可以减少上行数据，但“降低100倍以上”没有传感器采样率、原始/特征载荷大小、保留原始数据比例、压缩配置或实测前后字节数作为依据。该数字只能作为设计预估，不能当作普遍效果。
records.recommendedAction: 明确这是模拟场景中的目标/示例估计；用具体传感器数量、采样率、窗口、原始报文及特征输出大小计算压缩/过滤比例，并报告精度或信息损失影响。

records.topic: Cross-continent data-center latency range as a design assumption
records.conclusion: 100–300ms 是跨洲链路的情景估计，不是任何两个数据中心之间固定的网络延迟范围。地理距离、路由、运营商、链路类型及测量方向（单向时延或 RTT）都会影响结果。
records.recommendedAction: 明确作为容量规划的初始假设；选定具体 region/site 后以代表性线路测量 RTT 与尾延迟，并注明网络路径、样本期和是否包含应用处理时间。

records.topic: Ten-way billing sharding reduces a two-hour task to twelve minutes only under ideal linear scaling

targets.claimNeedle: 理论耗时降至12分钟左右
每个执行器处理约10万商户的账单

records.conclusion: 100万商户按10个执行器均分，每个约10万；若单节点串行耗时2小时且工作量完全均匀、并行近乎线性，理想时间为120分钟/10=12分钟。实际时间还受分片倾斜、I/O、锁竞争、协调/合并、重试和下游容量影响。
records.recommendedAction: 把12分钟标成理想线性缩放估算；若作为预计完成时间，应补充负载分布、资源配置、协调开销及可复现的基准测试。

records.topic: 100 MB vehicle-edge offline buffer capacity as an illustrative setting
records.conclusion: 100MB 是案例中缓冲区容量的配置示例；是否足够取决于车辆数、消息频率、平均消息大小、最大离线时长、优先级/丢弃策略和持久化开销。
records.recommendedAction: 标记为示例参数；按车辆量×消息频率×平均载荷×目标离线时长估算容量，并预留索引、重试、复制和峰值裕量，验证满盘/恢复后的积压回放行为。

records.topic: Software maintenance type percentages are historical estimates, not universal proportions

sourceEvidence.title: Overview of Software Maintenance and Evolution
sourceEvidence.publisher: University at Albany course reference by Jeff Offutt
sourceEvidence.supports: 该教学参考指出，传统教材中的维护工作分布约为完善性50%、适应性25%、改正性21%、预防性4%，并注明这些百分比基于20世纪80年代初的研究，未必代表当前情形。
sourceEvidence.limitations: 这是历史性统计摘要而非所有组织的现状调查；其类别比例与20/25/50/5存在约数与归类差别，不能证明当前项目或所有行业均采用该比例。

sourceEvidence.title: Introduction to Software Maintenance
sourceEvidence.supports: 课程笔记以近似符号列出完善性约50%、适应性约25%、改正性约20%、预防性约5%的常见教学分布，与该参考提纲的约数一致。
sourceEvidence.limitations: 课程笔记是教学摘要，不是独立的现代抽样调查；只能支持其作为常见历史/教学近似值使用，不能证明普遍或当前适用。

records.conclusion: 20/25/50/5是常见的教学近似分布，但分类和来源口径并不完全一致。University at Albany 的维护演化教学参考指出，类似比例基于20世纪80年代初的研究，并列出21/25/50/4的分类；因此这些比例不能作为不分行业、年代、产品或维护活动分类的普遍定律。
records.recommendedAction: 保留“约”字并注明这是一种历史/教学估计；建议给出来源与历史时间边界。若在实际项目中使用维护活动比例，应基于本组织的工单、工时与分类口径重新统计，并解释应急/预防工作如何归类。
